sources.title: The AI That Went Bananas: Unpacking Google's Viral 'Nano Banana' Image ...
sources.snippet: What is Nano Banana and Why Did It Go Viral? In early August 2025, the AI community was captivated by a mystery. An unnamed, highly capable image-editing model suddenly appeared on the LMArena testing platform. It wasn't listed in any official directory, but its results were terrifyingly good, effortlessly outperforming established models like DALL-E and Midjourney.
